context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 testing completed successfully. Key features verified: 1) 7 new report types added: expense, inbound, outbound, excess, scrap, price_fluctuation, low_stock - all with chart_data for pie charts. 2) Technical & O&M reports merged into single 'technical_om' endpoint. 3) All 16 report types now have chart_data field for visualization. 4) Sticky sidebar implemented via DashboardLayout component wrapping all /dashboard/* routes. 5) Auto-save draft functionality works with 5-second debounce when customer name >= 2 chars. 6) Sensoper favicon configured in index.html. 7) Fixed auto-save validation issue - frontend now properly converts empty strings to valid defaults (0 for numbers, 'TBD' for required strings, null for optional fields).

bug_fixed.issue: Auto-save draft failing with 422 validation error
bug_fixed.root_cause: Frontend was sending empty strings for numeric fields (sanction_load_kw, etc.) and optional int fields (battery_capacity_ah) which failed Pydantic validation
bug_fixed.fix: Updated auto-save payload in SiteVisitForm.js to convert empty strings to appropriate defaults: 0 for required floats, null for optional ints, 'TBD' for required strings, and proper defaults for all nested objects
